subject: CLAIM Gen7 adaptive PresentationHinge motion-profile lane
body: Claiming a bounded Gen7 research lane: adaptive visual timing profile learned only from completed trusted Fold7 transitions. Scope: robust local aggregation of opening-duration, initial acceleration, mid-fold velocity, and cadence-specific presentation-latency priors; immutable per-attempt snapshotting; eligibility gates; corruption/version reset; deterministic/fuzz safety proof. Excludes predictor/reacquisition control law, host migration/readiness, panel wake/routing, semantic thresholds, privacy policy, diagnostics identity design, and production integration. No production writes.
